skills.trigger: When evaluating a cystic lung lesion to determine its precise anatomical location and internal characteristics on a PA chest radiograph.
steps: Identify the cystic lesion and assess its vertical position relative to the hemidiaphragm and hilum to confirm lower lobe localization.
Examine the interior of the cyst for linear opacities representing vessels, noting specifically if they are located in the upper, middle, or lower portion of the cavity.

skills.trigger: When correlating findings between PA and lateral chest radiographs to verify the visibility of specific intracystic structures.
steps: Confirm the presence of a vessel within the cystic lesion on the PA view.
Systematically scan the corresponding region on the lateral view to determine if the intracystic vessel is visible or obscured, distinguishing cases where the finding is projection-dependent.
